ModuleCarried.SpecificEffects:
DMG dealt increases by <color=#F74848>12%</color>. When there are <color=#F74848>2</color> or more enemy units within attack range, DMG dealt additionally increases by <color=#F74848>6%</color> for each <color=#F74848>1</color> additional unit, up to <color=#F74848>12%</color>.
<buf ID=900017>[Fixed DMG]</buf> dealt increases by <color=#F74848>25%</color>. When actively attacking, Firepower increases by <color=#F74848>2%</color> of current HP.
